description: Search GitHub from https://github.com/search. type=repositories (default, 仓库) | users (用户) | issues (issue) | pull-requests (PR) switches the result tab (pull-requests maps to the URL value 'pullrequests'); sort=best-match (default, 最佳匹配) | stars (最多 star, repositories only) | updated (最近更新) orders results — sort is only effective for repositories (GitHub ignores it for other types). limit (default 10, 1-50) caps results; >10 paginates via ?p=N. Returns matched entries with name/login/title, URL, description/bio, language, stars/followers, update/created time (fields vary by type), plus GitHub's total result_count. Reads the rendered search page; no login required.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search keyword, e.g. rust. Non-empty required.（搜索关键词，如 rust，必填。）

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Result type: repositories (default, 仓库) | users (用户) | issues (issue) | pull-requests (PR). The pull-requests value is sent to GitHub as 'pullrequests' (the hyphenated form silently falls back to repositories).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order: best-match (default, 最佳匹配) | stars (most stars / 最多 star) | updated (recently updated / 最近更新). Only effective for type=repositories; for users/issues/pull-requests GitHub ignores sort and returns best-match.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum results to return (1-50, default 10). Values above 10 paginate through the search page (?p=N).（条数上限。）
